name: self-test-node-pnpm-only
description: H1 self-test fixture (review finding): a standard pnpm-only Node repo (packageManager field + pnpm-lock.yaml, deliberately NO package-lock.json). Before this fix, native `npm ci` hard-failed here on every PR (EUSAGE: npm ci requires an existing package-lock.json). Proves node_package_manager detection + dispatch works end-to-end for a real, non-npm repo shape.
